title: AC1027 DXF ACDSDATA raw owner-key retry control
scope: Correct the malformed ACDSDATA retry oracle in the existing generated test owner
Preserve DXF section-level ACDSDATA and owner-key semantics
Do not promote synthetic SAB framing to ACIS geometry evidence

observed.beforeCorrection: The repaired DXF roundtrip retained ACDSRECORD group-320 owner key 413 and its 256-byte SAB payload, but the test incorrectly expected DRW_ModelerGeometry::dataStorageData to contain that DXF section payload; it was empty.
observed.contract: DXF import retains ACDSDATA as a raw section. For this route, association is validated by the section record's group-320 owner key matching the modeler entity handle; dataStorageData is typed DWG DataStorage state.
observed.selectorCoverage: Valid five-record section; omitted-middle-chunk and reordered-chunk refusal; existing destination sentinel preservation; repaired export through the same exporter; ASCII/Binary re-import and exact record/chunk/owner closure.
observed.afterCorrection: Focused selector passes for ASCII and Binary.

assessment.limitations: Payload bytes are synthetic SAB framing and this result establishes raw DXF record preservation and owner-key association only. It does not establish a valid ACIS body, B-rep semantics, native acceptance, or the broad owning CTest.

workingTree.reason: The shared worktree has extensive pre-existing user changes; no unrelated files were staged or changed by this slice.
